scope: Focused exact source and canonical-sense comparison for two deferred lower-owner rows. No decision or manifest edit.

items.sourceMeaning: Based firmly on evidence; grounded is a physical metaphor.
items.reason: Source argument is evidence-based. Canonical 798 describes a person emotionally calm and connected to ordinary reality; its broad `was grounded` match is a subject/sense false positive. Prior independent collision audits agree.
items.recommendation: Retain proposed-new 2279 and author a bounded `grounded in facts/evidence` lesson. Do not alias to 798; target regex must require `in facts/evidence` so personal grounded examples remain 798.

items.sourceMeaning: Become evident or noticeable; the phrasal verb describes how an abstract quality appears.
items.reason: Source effects become visible in results. Canonical 364 means reliable support for a person; draft 2123 means human arrival at an event. Neither teaches abstract-result emergence, but both existing surface detectors match bare `show up` in the source without subject/sense discrimination. Source 4221 repeats the same guide example and should share whichever owner is chosen.
items.recommendation: Do not alias by bare-string match. Hold 2514 pending a reviewed subject/context-aware ownership and detector strategy, then draft only if the checker can distinguish abstract evidence from human arrival/support without false positives. Alternatively add a clearly tagged abstract sense to an existing show-up owner after editorial approval.
